subject: Budget review
body:
Budget reconciliation — working explanation

The banner appears twice because Ben copied a purchasing row for a classroom example. Theo is checking the hidden subtotal as well as the visible rows; deleting a line from view did not remove it from every calculation.

Open items: identify the total for review; separate Rosa's cleaning supplies from party materials; attach the monitor replacement quote to Lena's existing request. None of those changes is a new purchase.

I've left the earlier totals visible with labels. Please don't erase the trail just to make the sheet look calmer. Rafael
